start: Linked member with an active plan; Gym tab, 'My gym', 'My membership' card

steps.action: Tap 'Pause my plan'
user_sees: Sheet 'Pause my plan': 'Tap the first day you will be away, then the last day. The desk adds those days to the end of your plan.'
must_not: A price shown, or days before today offered

steps.action: Tap a first day, then a last day
user_sees: The range marked; until the end is picked: 'Now tap the last day of your pause.'
must_not: A start after the end accepted

steps.action: Tap 'Send to the desk'
user_sees: 'Pause <d> to <d> (<n> days). Request sent. The desk will confirm.' and 'Take back my request'
must_not: Two requests from one send, or 'Request sent' when the save failed

steps.action: Desk approves in the panel; member opens the card
user_sees: 'Your plan is paused. It now ends <date>.' and 'Got it'
must_not: The old end date shown after approval

start: Member wants to renew; also reached from 'Renew my plan' under a locked 'Ask a trainer'

steps.action: Tap 'Renew my plan' (on the card or under the locked trainer ask)
user_sees: Gym tab 'My gym' from the top with the plan list open: 'Pick a plan. The desk sets it up, and you pay at the desk.'
must_not: The plan list opening by surprise on a later visit (request older than 15 s is dropped)

steps.action: Pick a plan, tap 'Send to the desk'
user_sees: 'Renew: <plan>. Request sent. The desk will confirm.'
must_not: A price or a pay button in the app

steps.action: Gym offers no plans to pick
user_sees: 'Your gym has no plans to pick here yet. Ask the desk.'
must_not: An empty list with a live send button

start: Bad input or a refusal from the server

steps.action: Pick a start in the past / over 90 days ahead / a pause over 365 days
user_sees: 'Pick today or a later day.' / 'A pause can start up to 90 days from today.' / 'A pause can be up to 365 days.'
must_not: The request sent with dates the server will refuse

steps.action: Send the same pause again
user_sees: 'You already asked for this. The desk will answer soon.'
must_not: A second request row

steps.action: Many sends in one day / no active plan / gym suspended
user_sees: 'You have sent a lot of requests today...' / 'You need an active plan to pause. Ask the desk.' / 'Your gym is not taking requests in the app right now. Ask the desk.'
must_not: A raw code such as TOO_MANY on screen

steps.action: No internet on send
user_sees: "Couldn't send it. Check your internet and try again."
must_not: 'Request sent' shown for a failed send

start: A request is waiting, then taken back; another is declined

steps.action: Tap 'Take back my request'
user_sees: The request goes; the two buttons come back
must_not: The desk still seeing the request after it was taken back

steps.action: Desk declines a later request; member opens the card
user_sees: '<what>. The desk could not do this request. Please ask them.' and 'Got it'
must_not: The decline shown as done

steps.action: Tap 'Got it'
user_sees: The answer stops showing (told to the server as seen)
must_not: The same answer back on every open

start: Member sends a pause request

steps.action: Send the request
user_sees: Only this gym's desk sees it; no price is shown in the app
must_not: Another member or another gym seeing the request

start: Member trains on a pass (FITPASS, cultpass); 'My membership' card

steps.action: Open Gym tab, 'My gym'
user_sees: 'You train at <gym> with <pass>. There is no plan to renew.'
must_not: 'Pause my plan' or 'Renew my plan' offered for a plan the member does not have

start: Pass member reaches a pause anyway (old app, or a plan still running beside the pass)

steps.action: Send a pause
user_sees: 'You need an active plan to pause. Ask the desk.' when no plan runs
must_not: A pause saved against a pass

start: Desk moves a paying member to a pass while an old plan still runs

steps.action: Open 'My membership'
user_sees: The pass words win, as the panel shows
must_not: Renew buttons for the old plan beside the pass words

steps.action: A pending request from before the move
user_sees: The request line still shows until answered or taken back
must_not: The pending request lost without a word
